mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPI YoY and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS trends and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS changes and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between HOUST and UNRATE on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS levels and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
